name: Premium Cigar Association (PCA)
notes: ALREADY CONTACTED. Has Associate and Industry Partner memberships (/memberships/associate-membership/ and /memberships/industry-partner-membership/); contact form has a Potential Vendor option; 2026-2027 media kit for advertising. No public member directory.

name: Cigar Association of America (CAA)
notes: Main US cigar manufacturer and importer trade group. Public member page https://www.cigarsusa.org/members/our-members/ lists 36 members (manufacturers/importers/suppliers e.g. AJ Fernandez; Arango; Miami Cigar; Phillips & King; Show Cigars; Santa Clara). Member portal has resources; no vendor listing page.

name: Nicotine Resource Consortium (formerly Tobacco Merchants Association / TMA)
notes: TMA rebranded 2025; members are manufacturers; leaf dealers; importers; wholesalers and suppliers. Sells info/newsletter subscriptions; phone 919-917-7449. Old tma@tma.org likely retired.

name: National Association of Tobacco Outlets (NATO)
notes: Retailer-focused but has Manufacturer and Associate member applications; publishes NATO News and webinars. Email is the address in the Email Us link (a named staff member).

name: Cigar Rights of America (CRA)
notes: Consumer/industry advocacy group backed by premium cigar makers; Email CRA button on contact page; has news and CRA Alerts. Low fit for a paid tool listing but reaches manufacturers.

name: Tobacco Reporter (trade magazine - news desk)
notes: Mike Macdonald News Director. Global B2B tobacco trade magazine (same Raleigh publisher as Nicotine Resource Consortium). Press-release / product-news channel.

name: Tobacco Reporter (trade magazine - engagements)
notes: Michelle Parisi Manager Relationships & Engagements. Advertising/sponsorship contact.

name: Cigar Journal (trade/consumer magazine)
notes: Publishes daily Cigar Industry news posts (manufacturer/association news); press-release channel. Austria-based publisher (Select Media).

name: Tobacco Business Magazine (Phillips & King)
notes: Contact Us button on advertise page. Magazine now distributed to Phillips & King customers (retail focus). P&K is also a CAA member.

name: Cigar Snob Magazine
notes: Also SALES@CIGARSNOBMAG.COM on same page. Consumer cigar magazine with industry readership; press/news channel.

name: Cigar Dojo (cigar media and community)
notes: Address appears on the About page. Cigar news site that covers small/boutique brand news; boutique makers read it. Low-to-medium fit.

name: Tobacco Asia (trade magazine)
notes: International B2B tobacco trade magazine (publisher October Multimedia). Low fit for US-only forms; reaches exporters to US.

name: Tobacconists' Association of America (TAA)
notes: NO PUBLIC EMAIL (PO Box 81152 Conyers GA; 770-597-6264). Has a 'Find TAA Manufacturers' associate-member directory at /associate-members/ (loads by script). Contact form only.

name: Chicago Pipe Show (pipe/pipe-tobacco trade show)
notes: NO PUBLIC EMAIL (contact form). Public 2026 vendors list at /2026-vendors-list/ is a source of small pipe-tobacco blenders; vendor/exhibitor guide available.

notes: Proof: https://salestaxhelp.com/industries/tobacco-excise-tax-audit-help (tobacco excise audit defense; refunds; compliance services; represents CA tobacco manufacturers/distributors). State-tax focus (CA). Partner emails also on /about (jmcclellan@ ddavis@).

name: Troutman Pepper Locke - Nicholas A. Ramos
notes: Bio: advises tobacco/nicotine makers on obtaining TTB/state permits; FDA registrations and federal excise tax; premium cigar website compliance. Law firm (tobacco & nicotine industry group).

name: Troutman Pepper Locke - Michael B. Jordan
notes: Bio: advised premium cigar manufacturers on FDA user fee disputes and refund claims; obtained ~$1M TTB tobacco excise refund. Strong fit for FDA 3852 / user-fee pain.

name: Keller and Heckman - Azim Chowdhury
notes: Partner in Tobacco and E-Vapor practice (https://www.khlaw.com/industries/tobacco-and-e-vapor). FDA tobacco regulatory focus (not TTB filing). Referral channel.

name: Keller and Heckman - Neelam Gill
notes: Counsel in Tobacco and E-Vapor practice; FDA/state/global compliance for tobacco makers. Referral channel.

name: Thompson Hine - Eric N. Heyer
notes: Leads Tobacco Alternatives & Nicotine Products practice (PMTAs; FDA). Mostly vapor/nicotine; weak fit for TTB forms.

name: Registrar Corp (FDA tobacco registration and listing)
notes: Offers Tobacco Registration Reporting and Listing; HPHC reporting; health documents for tobacco companies (importers/foreign makers). Partner/referral channel; does not advertise TTB reports.

name: Freyr Solutions (tobacco and nicotine regulatory)
notes: Proof: https://www.freyrsolutions.com/blog/registering-tobacco-products-in-the-us-a-comprehensive-guide (tobacco/nicotine regulatory incl. tax and excise guidance). Large global firm; also contactus@freyrsolutions.com.

name: JJCC Group (FDA tobacco/PMTA consulting)
notes: PMTA consulting for cigars; hookah; pipe and ENDS; post-market reporting. No TTB services. Footer mailto shows a different dev domain - use the displayed Info@jjccgroup.org.

name: A-1 Worldwide Logistics (customs broker - tobacco/cigar imports)
notes: Miami customs broker with a tobacco/cigar import guide; says recurring regulatory reporting (TTB/FDA) needs separate agreed scope. Good partner for importers needing 5220.6/3852. Phone 305-821-8995.

name: TreeStar Solutions (accounting for tobacco/vape businesses)
notes: Accounting firm page for tobacco/vape: excise tax compliance and inventory tracking. Retail/smoke-shop focus; TTB not mentioned. Medium-low fit.

name: Harbor Compliance (government filing service)
notes: Has a TTB agency page (https://www.harborcompliance.com/agency/united-states-alcohol-and-tobacco-tax-and-trade-bureau) offering help filing with TTB; tobacco filings not explicitly listed. Low fit; possible partner.

name: Global Import Agent (importer of record - alcohol and tobacco)
notes: NO PUBLIC EMAIL (form only; Tampa FL and Edinburgh offices). Proof page: TTB importer permits; TTB excise calculation/payment; FDA prior notice; audit prep for tobacco imports. Strong fit - use form.

name: Tobacco Tax Refund Inc.
notes: NO PUBLIC EMAIL (form; 888-628-0334). CPAs/attorneys doing tobacco tax refunds and audit defense incl. pipe tobacco; cigars; RYO.

notes: NO PUBLIC EMAIL. Tobacco excise filing software + outsourced compliance (federal/state/local; MSA; PACT). Possible competitor or partner - note before contacting.
